description: WTW is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that provides data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, and utilizing the global view and local expertise of its approximately 47,000 colleagues serving more than 140 countries and markets it helps organizations sharpen strategies, enhance resilience, motivate workforces and maximize performance, designing and delivering solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Its clients operate on a global and local scale in a multitude of businesses and industries throughout the world and generally range in size from large, major multinational corporations to middle-market domestic and international companies, and include many of the world's leading corporations, including approximately 93 percent of the FTSE 100, 89 percent of the Fortune 1000, and 92 percent of the Fortune Global 500 companies.
company_name: Willis Towers Watson Public Limited Company
